title: bus wait (expected result)
description: Bus v2.6, questions v2.7. One file $AB_HOME/waits/<agent>/@<slug>/<task_id>.json per delegated task whose result a session waits for, written atomically (tmp + rename). Created by whoever delegates (agent-bus-mcp bus_send expect_result / bus_expect, lib ab_expect); moved on by scripts/agent-team-os-wake.py and by the outcome of bus_gestisci / ab_gestisci (v2.8: stays expected across wakes; closed | expired; woken | seen | blocked are v2.6 final states). A task_id has a single wait bus-wide. Dot-files in the same folder (.wakes.log, .woken.json) belong to the wake script. Readers ignore unknown fields.

task_id.description: Canonical t-<YYYYMMDD>-<rand6>. Also the file name.

host.description: Machine of the waiting session; only that machine's wake script touches the file.

description.description: A few words, shown in the wake prompt and in the bus-band.

delegated_to.description: Address of whoever does the work.

deadline.description: Past it with no result: state expired and one notice in the waiter's inbox (no wake).

state.description: v2.8: expected = open, also after any number of wakes; closed = the waiter consumed a return with esito chiuso; expired = deadline passed with no return, or no movement for AB_WAIT_IDLE_H (note 'inattiva da N ore'). v2.6 final states, never reopened by the wake: woken (result arrived, prompt written once), seen (read before the wake), blocked (wake_chain). cancelled = withdrawn by hand. A riarma/risposto on a closed wait reopens it (reopened_from).

target.description: How to reach the waiting session's prompt, captured from its environment at registration.

pending_wake.description: Why the latest still-pending return is not woken yet: onda:working, onda:has_text, tmux:busy, tetto_orario (session), tetto_task, tetto_coppia, tetto_urgenti, onda_senza_guardia, nessun_canale, ... (v2.8: copied from returns for the band).

woken_via.description: onda | tmux, with :non_confermato when the submit was not seen on screen.

questions.description: v2.7, read-only since v2.8 (questions are returns of type question). Kept so questions handled before v2.8 do not wake again.

state.description: seen = read before any wake, already answered, or overtaken by the result.

answered_at.description: The waiter wrote in the question's thread after it.

delegation.description: v2.8. The delegation message and its thread, for hooking returns written as new messages.

executor_session.description: v2.8. agent/slug of the executor, learned from the first return (hooking by session).

returns.description: v2.8. Every message on the task that reached the waiter, by message id.

state.description: pending = not woken yet (pending_wake says why); woken = in a wake; seen = filed by the session before any wake, or a question already answered in its thread; handled = consumed with bus_gestisci (handled = esito).

last_activity.description: v2.8. Last return or outcome; the idle expiry counts from here.

closed_by.description: Message whose esito chiuso closed the wait.
